# Helpers used by the rewrite passes.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
prim any any
enum e a,b
union u1 i,s n=U1
union u2 u1,nul n=U2
union u3 i,d
union u4 s,e
union u5 u1,d in=U5
uinter x1 n=X1
members x1 i,any
uinter x2 n=X2
members x2 x1,s
cls c1 a:i,b:s n=C1
cls c2 a:d,b:s n=C2
cls c3 a:i n=C3
arr a1 c1
arr a2 c2
cls top a:u2,b:u3,c:u4,d:u5,e:x2,f:c1,g:c2,h:c3,i:a1,j:a2,k:e n=Top
top Top top
finish
print
